messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Dedicated pool 'oriontech-vpc-prod' GPU pressure detected. queue_length=132, avg_gpu_util=99%, 95p_latency=2400ms for tenant=OrionTech. Possible single-tenant hotspot.
ashley_oncall: I'm on it. Paging SRE + Prod. @mike_sre @raj_prod please ack.
mike_sre: acked. pulling metrics. looks like sustained QPS spike from a batch job hitting model v1.4 at 03:01 UTC.
raj_prod: oncall here, joining. any customer contacts?
sophie_support: I reached out to OrionTech CSM (emma@orion). They report elevated latency and some 502s on their end.
lucy_eng: adding logs: ``ERROR inferer: kv cache OOM, dropped frames=12`` — seems cache pressure causing retries + backoff.
ashley_oncall: important: this is a single-tenant dedicated pool (no other tenants to evict). We can't move them out. Options: (1) authorize burst (consume spare-reserve), (2) autoscale add nodes, (3) route overflow to hosted fallback model.
mike_sre: autoscale attempted but cloud quota prevents immediate new GPUs (VM quota reached in region). We have 2 GPUs in spare-reserve but need approval for burst override. ops-bot: current burst_tokens_available=2.
raj_prod: what's expected delta? how many GPUs to stabilize?
lucy_eng: quick calc: queue_length -> need +4 GPUs to bring 95p under 300ms for current load. With prefix caching warm, +2 reduces queue by ~60% but may not hit SLO.
sophie_support: OrionTech requests we prioritize availability over cost. They authorized temporary bursts last year for emergency (contact: legal ok).
ashley_oncall: propose: (A) immediate 2-GPU burst to spare-reserve to reduce tail, (B) route ~20% of heavy batch traffic to hosted fallback model gpt-slim-q4 (quantized) for 30m while infra requests quota increase for autoscale. Anyone object?
mike_sre: agree. I'll flip routing rule and monitor queue. Preparing command.
ashley_oncall: @raj_prod can you approve the 2-GPU burst? Need explicit ok in thread for auditing.
raj_prod: approved. authorize-burst --pool oriontech-vpc-prod --gpus 2 --reason "emergency tenant hotspot"
ops-bot: action accepted: scheduled burst +2 GPUs from spare-reserve -> oriontech-vpc-prod. ETA ~90s.
mike_sre: routing change applied: traffic selector (tenant=OrionTech & request.type=batch & model=v1.4) -> fallback=gpt-slim-q4 for 18% of requests. Watching error rates.
lucy_eng: logs: fallback success rate 100%, latency 95p down to ~420ms for routed requests. primary queue shrinking.
ashley_oncall: monitoring: queue_length down to 48, avg_gpu_util 86% after burst. 95p now 760ms overall. Still above target but improving.
sophie_support: updated OrionTech that we're doing burst + partial routing. They asked for ETA on full recovery.
raj_prod: request cloud quota increase ticket opened (infra-requests#5912). If approved in 10-15m we'll autoscale +4. If not, keep burst and extend routing.
mike_sre: note: there's a risk of cache churn if we switch too many requests to fallback; keep <=25% routed.
ashley_oncall: agree. set: routing_pct=18, burst=+2. continue 1:1 handoff to @mike_sre after the active 30m window.
ashley_oncall: action items: 1) mike_sre monitor next 30m + escalate to infra if quota delayed. 2) lucy_eng capture root cause (why batch job spiked cache). 3) prod to schedule postmortem with OrionTech. I'll create incident ticket and update status page.
raj_prod: acknowledged. assigning follow-ups. good call on fallback route.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0412-oriontech-gpu-hotspot. Severity: P2. Contributors: ashley_oncall, mike_sre, raj_prod, lucy_eng, ops-bot, sophie_support.
ashley_oncall: handing off to @mike_sre for monitoring. Leaving channel but reachable. :white_check_mark:
mike_sre: taking over. will post updates. current plan holds. last metrics snapshot at 8043220398.
ops-bot: note: billing tag applied: cost_center=oriontech, surge_mode=emergency-burst.
